retrievalProfile.description: A full-body portrait of a subject centered within a blue-tinted industrial steel bridge structure featuring mirrored display typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, full-body portrait of a man in Western attire standing on a wooden-planked bridge. The scene is dominated by a repeating geometric steel truss system, all unified by a cool blue color grade. Large, thin-stroke sans-serif text is placed at the top and bottom, with the bottom text being a vertically flipped mirror of the top.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered within the vanishing point of the bridge trusses
Typography framing the top and bottom edges of the composition
Cool blue environment contrasting with the subject's dark clothing
Geometric repetition of the bridge structure creating depth
coreInvariants: Monochromatic blue color cast on the environment

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body subject centered horizontally, occupying the middle vertical third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's crossed arms and the central vanishing point of the bridge.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the bridge trusses toward the center, then moves vertically between the top and bottom mirrored text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The sky and bridge structure provide a complex but tonally consistent negative space around the subject.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Steel blue and cyan tones across the bridge and sky.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black and dark navy in the subject's shirt and hat.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pale tan or gold for the bottom mirrored text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value in the sky, medium saturation in the blue tones, and high contrast in the subject's silhouette.

characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'K' features a leg that meets the stem at a high point
The 'R' has a large open bowl

treatment.outline: Thin black drop shadow for legibility

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used in two different colors and orientations.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric circularity and sharp vertices.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a full-body photo of a man in a black t-shirt, jeans, and a black cowboy hat standing on a wooden bridge. The bridge should have a complex blue-tinted steel truss structure receding into the distance. Apply a strong blue color grade to the entire scene except the subject's skin tones.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of uppercase geometric sans-serif text across the top in white. Duplicate the text, change the color to pale gold, flip it vertically, and place it at the bottom edge.

verificationChecks: Is the bottom text a perfect vertical mirror of the top?
Is the entire bridge structure tinted blue?
Is the subject centered in the frame?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the blue color grade
Complexity of the bridge truss pattern
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the artist
Any brand logos on the belt buckle
Specific name used in the text

avoid: Cluttered backgrounds without a vanishing point

postGenerationChecks: Check for geometric alignment of the bridge trusses
Ensure the blue tint is consistent across the sky and steel
Verify the mirrored text is legible despite the flip
Confirm the subject's pose is confident and centered
recipe.reuseFormula: Industrial Structure + Monochromatic Tint + Mirrored Geometric Typography
